rationale: EO 9447 only rewrites five subsections of EO 9356 (clothing allowances for enlisted Navy and Coast Guard personnel). Three are fiscal-year-1945 rate rows that lapsed by their own wording on June 30, 1945; the other two continued inside EO 9356 until EO 9744B (June 29, 1946, effective for fiscal year 1947) superseded EO 9356 and EO 9447 by name. The Federal Register catalog observation (superseded by EO 9744-B, June 29, 1946) and the 1989 codification observation agree, and the held Federal Register text of EO 9744B names EO 9447 in its supersession sentence. No held source shows a revival, so the order is not in force on 2026-10-14.
